clue.text: Struggle to capture good clear picture

indicators.note: to capture is to hold something inside, so the struggle word wraps round the rest

parts.note: to struggle or compete is to vie
clear as in clear profit, after deductions, is nett

explanation.surface: A photographer fights to get a clean, sharp image.
explanation.walkthrough: NETT is the British spelling of net, as in net (clear) earnings.
explanation.definitionFit: A vignette is a small illustration or a brief evocative scene, a kind of picture.

clue.text: One is unable to get off at night with this

definitions.text: One is unable to get off at night with this

parts.words: One is unable to get off at night with this
parts.note: get off means fall asleep, not leave a vehicle; the condition stops sleep

explanation.surface: Someone stuck aboard at night, unable to alight.
explanation.definitionFit: Insomnia is the chronic inability to fall asleep or stay asleep.

clue.text: States chairman tore round

indicators.note: round suggests turning things about, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A chairman declares he has been tearing around.
explanation.definitionFit: The United States lie within this continent, so States stands for it loosely.

clue.text: Ronald's in the ceremonial seat

indicators.note: in places the name inside the word the

parts.note: Ron is the short form of Ronald; the 's means is

explanation.surface: Ronald occupies the seat of state.
explanation.definitionFit: A throne is the chair of state used by a monarch on formal occasions.

clue.text: Second hearing

parts.note: a sound reflected back is heard a second time, not a court rehearing

explanation.definitionFit: An echo is a reflected sound, so the original noise reaches the ear again.

clue.text: Morass of papers about meeting

indicators.note: about means the papers word goes round the meeting abbreviation

parts.note: a quire is a set of 24 or 25 sheets of paper
AGM is an annual general meeting

explanation.surface: A mess of documents concerning a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A quagmire is a bog, and figuratively an awkward, entangling situation.

clue.text: Month accompanying a star

parts.note: Nov is the abbreviation for November

explanation.surface: A month spent in the company of a celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: A nova is a star that suddenly flares to great brightness before fading.

clue.text: Such a person does not necessarily look sad

definitions.text: Such a person does not necessarily look sad

parts.words: Such a person does not necessarily look sad
parts.note: blue can mean sad and eyed can mean looked, but the phrase describes eye colour

explanation.surface: A remark that someone may not seem unhappy at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A favourite or darling is called blue-eyed, from having eyes of that colour, unrelated to gloom.

clue.text: Sort of cloudier fuel that's unrefined

indicators.note: a sort of something is a version of it, so the letters of the next word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Murkier fuel is the kind that has not been through a refinery.
explanation.definitionFit: Petroleum straight from the ground, before refining, is the fuel known by this name.

clue.text: One employing you and me with hesitation

parts.note: you and me together are us
er is the sound of hesitating

explanation.surface: An employer of the two of us who keeps hesitating.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who employs, or makes use of, something is a user of it.

clue.text: Road, although not smooth, decidedly driveable in the end

parts.note: tho is the informal short form of although
something not smooth is rough
decidedly, as in decidedly better, means far (far better)

indicators.note: in the end points to the final letter of the word driveable

explanation.surface: A bumpy road that you can still definitely drive along.
explanation.definitionFit: A thoroughfare is a main road or public street carrying traffic through a place.

clue.text: Christmas gift that could create genuine anger

parts.note: a frank person is open and genuine
to incense is to anger

explanation.surface: A present that might provoke real fury.
explanation.definitionFit: Frankincense was one of the gifts the Magi brought to the infant Jesus in the Nativity story.

clue.text: Where to put memory card secretly

definitions.meaning: a memory card is slotted inside a camera
the legal term for proceedings held in private

explanation.surface: Instructions on storing a memory card discreetly.
explanation.definitionFit: A court sitting in camera excludes the public, so the phrase means privately; literally a card goes into the device.

clue.text: Be of assistance when a small number suffer

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five, a small number
to ail is to suffer from illness

explanation.surface: Helping out when a few people are in distress.
explanation.definitionFit: To avail is to help or benefit, as in to no avail.

clue.text: From one point of view at home then not at home

parts.note: someone at home is in
someone not at home is away

explanation.surface: A perspective that sees someone both home and out at once.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something is true in a way means it holds partly, from a certain perspective.

clue.text: Something green almost exhausted

indicators.note: almost means the word falls one letter short of complete, losing its final letter

parts.note: someone exhausted or worn out is jaded

explanation.surface: A green thing that has nearly run out of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Jade is a green gemstone, and its name is also used for that shade of green.

clue.text: One-piece athletic wear?

parts.note: read as kit for a jumping athlete, but it means any all-in-one garment

explanation.definitionFit: A jumpsuit is an all-in-one garment covering body, arms and legs, originally worn by parachutists.

clue.text: Look round lake's shiny surface

indicators.note: round means the look word goes around the abbreviation for lake

parts.note: to gaze is to look steadily
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: Staring across a lake at its glittering water.
explanation.definitionFit: A glaze is a glossy coating, as on pottery or pastry, giving a gleaming finish.

clue.text: Appreciative having a rug manufactured with felt

indicators.note: something manufactured is put together, so these letters are assembled anew

explanation.surface: Pleased with a rug that was made from felt.
explanation.definitionFit: Being grateful means feeling thankful, which is appreciating what one has received.

clue.text: Good sort

definitions.meaning: a ... person is good to others
a sort of thing is a ... of thing

explanation.surface: A decent sort of person.
explanation.definitionFit: Kind is both an adjective for benevolent behaviour and a noun meaning type or variety.

clue.text: Sons supporting hype? That's unnecessary

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means the sons come below the other piece

parts.note: hype is slang for a hypodermic, which is a needle
S is the abbreviation for son, so two sons are SS

explanation.surface: Boys backing publicity that nobody needed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hype' looks like publicity but is short for hypodermic.
explanation.definitionFit: Needless describes something that is not required, which is what unnecessary means.

clue.text: Maid swaps a name, becoming another woman?

indicators.note: swaps means two letters change places, here the a and the n for name

parts.note: Maid Marian is Robin Hood's companion, so the maid gives Marian

explanation.surface: A maid changes her name and turns into somebody else.
explanation.walkthrough: In MARIAN the last A and N (name) change places, giving MARINA; 'a' names the letter swapped with the N.
explanation.definitionFit: Marina is a female first name, so it is another woman besides Marian; the question mark flags the example.

clue.text: Shrub to finish amongst seaweed

indicators.note: amongst means the finish word sits inside the seaweed word

parts.note: laver is an edible seaweed, used in Welsh laverbread
the finish of something is its end

explanation.surface: A plant that ends up growing among the seaweed.
explanation.definitionFit: Lavender is a fragrant purple-flowered bush of the mint family.

clue.text: Virginia to decant gas

parts.note: VA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Virginia
to decant wine is to pour it

explanation.surface: A Virginian decanting fumes.
explanation.definitionFit: Vapour is a substance in its gaseous state, such as steam or mist.

clue.text: Do particularly well as pattern-maker

definitions.meaning: to behave so well that others should copy you
literally, someone who sets an example produces a pattern or model to follow

explanation.surface: Excelling as a designer of patterns.
explanation.definitionFit: Setting an example means acting as a model; an example is a pattern for others to copy.

clue.text: Sea may do this to ship

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: A rough sea throws a vessel about.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue reads as one description, but 'to' is taken as written and 'ship' gives SS.
explanation.definitionFit: To toss is to throw about, as a stormy ocean pitches a boat up and down.

clue.text: Pronounced fit, a murder victim!

indicators.note: pronounced means the word is said aloud and spelt another way

parts.note: fit, as in fit to do something, means able

explanation.surface: Declared healthy, and yet a homicide victim.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Abel is killed by his brother Cain, the first murder in the Bible.

clue.text: Man in casino elaborated

indicators.note: in signals that the name sits inside the run of letters across the next two words

explanation.surface: A man inside a casino, embellished.
explanation.definitionFit: Noel is a male first name, so it is a man in crossword terms.

clue.text: Not adequately protected in dry river

parts.note: sec is the French wine term for dry
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Something left unguarded in a river that has run dry.
explanation.definitionFit: Insecure means unsafe or vulnerable, lacking proper defence.

clue.text: Generous giving in Scotland's capital, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means what follows is said aloud and spelt differently

parts.note: the capital letter of Scotland is S, and a capital is a large letter, so a large S

explanation.surface: Lavish handouts in Edinburgh, so people say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scotland's capital' looks like Edinburgh but is the capital (large) letter S; LARGE S said aloud gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Largesse is liberality in bestowing gifts or money, especially on a grand scale.
